topic: event listener never removed on component unmount, firing on stale instance
question: Quick reminder — what was the actual root cause?
butterfly_answer: `.bind(this)` in lifecycle methods creates a new function reference on every call, so the reference passed to `removeEventListener` / `priceStream.off` never matched the one that was registered — listeners accumulated and were never cleaned up.
lastN_answer: The prior context doesn't identify a root cause for anything. The CI timeout flakiness was flagged as possibly resource contention or test order sensitivity, but never diagnosed. No root cause was established.
needle_fact: Calling this.handleResize.bind(this) inside componentDidMount and again inside componentWillUnmount produces two different function references, so window.removeEventListener and priceStream.off never actually detach the original listeners registered at mount time.
